prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: an avocado halved with one knife stroke and twisted open, the pit popping out. The camera slides to salmon fillets searing skin-down, crackling loudly, then to a handful of nuts and seeds scattering across a grain bowl in slow motion, backlit. Money shot: the seared salmon laid over the vibrant bowl, a soft egg cut open on top, yolk flooding gold through the grains. Final beat: the bowl beside an open notebook and a black coffee, morning light raking across. Warm side light, deep shadows, macro textures, film grain. Dominant sound: the skin crackle, then the seeds scattering. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
